name: From the Great Saltworks of Salins-les-Bains to the Royal Saltworks of Arc-et-Senans, the Production of Open-pan Salt
description: In eastern France, near Besançon, this site links two saltworks joined by a 21 km wooden pipeline that carried brine from Salins-les-Bains to Arc-et-Senans. Claude Nicolas Ledoux began the semicircular Royal Saltworks in 1775, laying it out like a palace for industry. At Salins, a 13th-century underground gallery still has a working 19th-century pump.
